body.x: Mobilint Inc. (CEO Dong-joo Shin) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

Mobilint is an AI semiconductor startup that was established in 2019 to realize the limitless potential of AI technology to make a safer and more convenient world. In addition to CEO Dongjoo Shin, who researched AI semiconductors for deep learning for a long time at KAIST and developed the Edge ASIC Chip, the team composed of experts in AI, software, and semiconductor design was able to produce top level results in MLPerf, a global AI semiconductor benchmarking test, and had its technical capabilities recognized within a year of its founding, being registered as a MLPerf Founding Member. They have been able to attract around 10 billion KRW in private investments and 9 billion in government sponsored R&D funds, accelerating their technology development.

With Aries, their first ASIC product, being released, they attended the trade show to raise awareness for their product. Mobilint explained that Aries is a powerful and efficient product that can replace GPUs and said that companies that supply products or services related to computer vision can create a more powerful product with better marketability using Aries. Moreover, Aries is a high-performance, high-efficiency chip for edge computing, and can be utilized excellently in smart factories and smart cities, which require a high level of performance. Mobilint said that it is also a good fit for industries that use high-performance computer vision technology.

A spokesman for Mobilint said that, “We developed Aries, the AI semiconductor, for edge computing. Aries has an excellent calculation performance due to its structure optimized for deep learning algorithm model calculations. Aries’ hardware architecture is designed for deep learning algorithm calculations, resulting in high efficiency and data reuse rates, enabling high performance with low power consumption. Aries’ max performance of 80 TOPS is the highest level from Edge based processors.” They emphasized that, “It also supports user-friendly ‘Software Development Kit (SDK)’, enabling first time users to easily use it. Aries is ready to gift clients with an incredible experience.”

They also went into the development background. A spokesman explained that, “The development of AI technology resulted in the emergence of numerous more convenient and efficient products and services, but the amount of data to process has also risen explosively, highlighting the necessity of specialized AI hardware with powerful capabilities. The GPU solution most commonly used in AI algorithm model data processing falls short in market demands in many aspects, such as performance, power efficiency, size, heat generation, and price, leaving many limitations in implementing AI applications.”

They went on to say, “The Neural Processing Unit (NPU) is hardware optimized for AI algorithm model acceleration. Even though the maturity of the technology isn’t high yet, it already has the outstanding potential to exceed the performance of GPUs in certain conditions. Mobilint believed that NPU will quickly grow and overtake GPU in the field of AI and was sure that it wouldn’t be too far into the future. As there isn’t any one product that dominates the global NPU market currently, we deemed that this was the best time, as the opportunity was open to everyone, and jumped into developing NPU ourselves as we were confident in our technology, which was advanced over years of research.”

Currently, Mobilint formed partnerships with Korean companies in various fields, such as smart factories, smart cities, and autonomous driving vehicles, and is raising sales through PoC. Sales are projected to rise explosively when mass production begins in earnest in 2024.

They announced plans to apply Aries to computer vision products and services which require high performance, such as smart factories and smart cities. A spokesman said, “Though we will conduct PoC centered on solutions with high marketability, we will form partnerships with companies in fields with high potential, such as self-driving cars, and prepare for the future.” They went on to announce their business plans, saying, “Mobilint plans to understand the domain of their clients through PoC and find optimal solutions to solve issues that occur on-site and apply them to the company’s hardware design. In addition, we seek to improve the level of perfection of our various support software and improve user convenience.”
They went on to say, “We hope CES 2023 will be an opportunity for the world to experience our efficient solutions.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
* Special Report Team : Joseph Choe, Kidai Kim, Dongkwan Kim, Mokkyung Lee, Sangun Choi, Joon Suh Lee, Yeawon Choi, Jinnsun Park, Seung Hyun Nam, Min Seok Cha
